name: term_fetus
description: Literature reference values for a human fetus in utero at 40+0 weeks (3.545 kg): healthy, appropriate for gestational age, singleton, mother at rest breathing air, not in labour. Grades: A = human fetal data at term, B = human fetal data from late gestation (36-38 wk), a pooled synthesis or a short extrapolation, C = derived, method-dependent, or ovine (marked 'C ovine').
state: fetus in utero, 40+0 wk, 3.545 kg; placenta is the gas exchanger; fluid-filled lungs, no fetal breathing; wide-open ductus arteriosus and foramen ovale; amniotic environment ~37.3 degC

variables.label: Heart rate (CTG baseline)
variables.notes: Mean CTG baseline at week 40: 135.2-136.0 (95 % CI of the mean, Pildner von Steinburg 2013); normal 120-160. Quiet/active sleep 134/144 at 36-40 wk (Boito 2004).

variables.label: Systolic arterial pressure
variables.notes: Ovine: MAP 50 + near-term ovine pulse pressure ~20.

variables.label: Diastolic arterial pressure
variables.notes: Ovine, see sbp.

variables.label: Mean arterial pressure
variables.notes: User decision 50. Fetal sheep at 140-141 d (term 145): baroreflex midpoint pressure 54 +/- 3 mmHg (cortisol-replete; 45 +/- 2 adrenalectomised), MAP +13 in the first hour after delivery (Segar 2002); Unno 1999: FABP rises linearly 120-140 d. Human cross-check: term_neonate at 72 h MAP 58. Archived term_fetus ran 55.

variables.label: Pulse pressure
variables.notes: Ovine.

variables.label: PA minus aorta, mean pressure
variables.notes: Wide-open duct: no LV-RV pressure difference in direct human measurements (Johnson 2000). Fetal invariant (docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Atrial (central venous) pressure
variables.notes: Johnson 2000: both atria equal and constant 16-29 wk; the value itself is in the scanned PDF only (requested from the user).

variables.label: LV end-systolic volume
variables.notes: EDV - SV.

variables.label: LV stroke volume
variables.notes: MRI at 37 wk: aorta 41 % of CVO 465 = 191 mL/kg/min / HR ~140.

variables.label: LV ejection fraction
variables.notes: 4D-echo (Hamill 2011 LV 72 vs RV 62; Simioni reverses the order); method-dependent.

variables.label: RV end-systolic volume
variables.notes: EDV - SV.

variables.label: RV stroke volume
variables.notes: MRI at 37 wk: pulmonary trunk 56 % of CVO 465 = 261 mL/kg/min / HR ~140.

variables.label: RV ejection fraction
variables.notes: Zhang 62.3 +/- 4.2; Hamill 62.4.

variables.label: RV share of combined output
variables.notes: MRI 56-58 %, Rasanen 60 % at 38 wk, Mielke 59 %.

variables.label: Pulmonary blood flow, share of CVO
variables.notes: MRI at 37 wk 16 % (+/-2SD 0-34); Rasanen ~21-25 %, flat after 30 wk.

variables.label: Foramen ovale flow (R->L), share of CVO
variables.notes: MRI 29 % (7-51); Rasanen ~18 % after 30 wk. Identity: LV 42 = FO 24 + lungs 18.

variables.label: Ductus arteriosus flow (PA->Ao), share of CVO
variables.notes: Identity RV 58 - lungs 18; MRI 41 %.

variables.label: Placental (umbilical) share of CVO
variables.notes: User decision 25: MRI 29 % (Prsa 2014) vs Doppler ~21 % after 32 wk (Kiserud 2006); the methods disagree.

variables.label: Umbilical vein flow
variables.notes: MRI 129-134 (36-37 wk); Doppler falls toward term (Acharya 2005), ~70 at 36-40 wk (Boito 2004).

variables.label: Descending aorta flow, share of CVO
variables.notes: MRI term 55 % (252 mL/kg/min); includes the umbilical arteries.

variables.label: Cerebral blood flow
variables.notes: Grade C derived: ~75 % of SVC 137 mL/kg/min (Sun 2015 cerebral O2 delivery), as at 30 wk.

variables.label: Ductus venosus shunt fraction of UV flow
variables.model_readout: none (no ductus venosus in the model)
variables.notes: Reference only (no ductus venosus in the model). ~20-25 % in normal late-gestation fetuses (Kiserud 2006).

variables.label: Ductus arteriosus diameter
variables.notes: Anatomy: Szpinda regression 0.2072 + 0.0935 x 40 = 3.95 mm. As at 30 wk, PA ~ Ao is the real target and the model's duct size is a calibration lever (the archived term_fetus needed 6.0 mm).

variables.label: Foramen ovale diameter
variables.notes: Reference only: grows linearly with GA (Phillipos 1994); numbers not extractable from the abstract. FO size is not a split lever above ~2 mm (docs/fetal_circulation.md).

variables.label: Umbilical vein SO2
variables.notes: User decision 75: between cordocentesis week 40 (72.4 %, Siggaard-Andersen; mostly <= 38 wk data) and MRI at 36 wk (79 +/- 5 %, Sun 2015).

variables.label: Umbilical vein pO2
variables.notes: 4.20 kPa at week 40. Maternal placental venous blood ~38.9 mmHg: no diffusion equilibrium at term (~30 % apparent shunt).

variables.label: Umbilical vein pCO2
variables.notes: 5.08 kPa at week 40.

variables.label: Umbilical vein base excess
variables.notes: Calculated (ecf BE).

variables.label: Umbilical artery SO2
variables.notes: 50.8 % at week 40.

variables.label: UA minus UV pCO2
variables.notes: 5.0 mmHg at week 40.

variables.label: Ascending aorta (pre-ductal) SO2
variables.notes: MRI at 36 wk 58 +/- 6 %; consistent with UV 75 and the streaming at 30 wk.

variables.label: Thoracic IVC SO2
variables.notes: Derived (C): umbilical blood mixed with lower-body venous blood, as at 30 wk.

variables.label: SVC SO2
variables.notes: Derived (C): fetal mixed-venous pO2 2.2 kPa (16.5 mmHg) at week 40 (Siggaard-Andersen) at P50 ~22.

variables.label: Descending aorta SO2
variables.notes: = umbilical artery.

variables.label: Hb-O2 P50 (standard)
variables.notes: term_neonate model P50_0 20; Siggaard-Andersen in-vivo half-saturation 2.9 kPa (21.8) at week 40.

variables.label: Hemoglobin
variables.notes: Siggaard-Andersen week 40: 9.2 mmol/L = 14.8 g/dL; Nicolaides 1988 table rises ~0.2 g/dL/wk; term_neonate 17.0 includes the placental transfusion at birth.

variables.label: Hematocrit
variables.notes: Hb / MCHC ~33.

variables.label: Fetal haemoglobin fraction
variables.notes: 0.80 at week 40 (Siggaard-Andersen).

variables.label: Fetoplacental blood volume
variables.model_readout: sum of fetal + PL_* blood volumes / weight
variables.notes: Per kg falls with GA (MacGregor 1988); classic ~110 at term.

variables.label: Fetal body blood volume
variables.notes: Fetoplacental minus the placental share.

variables.label: Placental share of fetoplacental blood
variables.notes: Placenta:fetus mass ratio ~0.14 at term (0.21 at 30 wk).

variables.label: Oxygen consumption
variables.notes: Term: calorimetry 6.8 (Bonds 1986), umbilical uptake 0.29 mmol/min/kg = 6.5 (Acharya & Sitras); MRI 6.9 at 36 wk; Radaelli 5.4. Fick: with the cordocentesis saturations VO2 6.5 needs ~145 mL/kg/min of umbilical blood.

variables.label: Respiratory quotient
variables.notes: Fetal lamb: glucose + lactate + amino-acid oxidation.

variables.label: Core temperature
variables.notes: 0.3-0.5 degC above the mother; ~85 % of fetal heat leaves via umbilical blood (lamb). Environment = amniotic fluid ~37.3 degC.

variables.label: Plasma glucose (UV)
variables.notes: Fetal glucose falls with GA and the maternal-fetal gap widens (Marconi 1996): ~1 mmol/L below the mother at term.

variables.label: Lactate
variables.notes: Stable across GA in AGA fetuses. Cord lactate at birth (~3.7) is a labour value.

variables.label: Fetal urine production
variables.notes: Reference only. Rabinowitz 1989 51 mL/h at 40 wk (14 mL/kg/h); Touboul 2008 125 mL/h (35 mL/kg/h).

variables.label: Plasma creatinine
variables.notes: Equilibrates with the mother across the placenta.

variables.label: GFR
variables.notes: Reference only: not measurable in the fetus.

variables.label: Cystatin C
variables.notes: Reference only; GA-independent, does not cross the placenta.

variables.label: Crown-heel length
variables.notes: Reference only.

variables.label: Placental weight
variables.notes: Reference only; placenta:fetus ~0.14 at term.
